request.description: ONE monumental ancient drowned monarch STONE STATUE, isolated complete sprite. Upright broad heavy stone shoulders, robe carved as 3 broad vertical stone planes, chunky plinth at the bottom, memorial sculpture at building scale. Entire object is weathered blue teal stone including crown, eyes, beard and trident. Empty carved eye sockets, never glowing or living eyes, no flesh, no gold. Occupied width about 100 pixels height about 145; leave transparent margins around ALL tips and full plinth. Crisp native pixels, large economical clusters, limited shading, strong deliberate edges. NO cast shadow, no scenery, no floor beyond the sculpture plinth, no background, no bubbles, coral, writing, UI, living character, painterly shading or anti aliasing.

request.description: ONE ancient partially broken underwater royal-court masonry ARCHWAY as an isolated native pixel-art prop. Straight-on front elevation, 2D sidescroller, NOT isometric. Broad rounded arch of large blue-green slate voussoir blocks, short sturdy thick square side piers with supporting foot blocks. Wide empty TRANSPARENT opening. The upper right outer rim is chipped away but inner arch remains connected and credible. Six or seven readable big stone wedges each side, very few cracks, two tiny barnacles attached in crevices. Controlled top-left planes, dark navy-blue recess edges and muted cyan bevel, chunky pixel clusters. Occupied width about 144 pixels, height about 112 with transparent clearance on ALL sides. No door, no gate, no floor, no backdrop, no sea vegetation, no coral wallpaper, no scenery collage, no text, interface or characters. No fine filigree, painted shading, blurry edges or cast shadow. Architecture should be strong and simple with a clear connected silhouette.
